{
 "title": "Create and verify task transform",
 "command": "mkdir -p programs && cat > programs/task-d1aa2d41.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 1]
    if len(points) < 2:
        return out
    points.sort()
    dr = points[1][0] - points[0][0]
    dc = points[1][1] - points[0][1]
    if dr <= 0 or dc <= 0 or any((b[0]-a[0], b[1]-a[1]) != (dr, dc) for a, b in zip(points, points[1:])):
        return out
    r, c = points[-1]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    while 0 <= r + dr < h and 0 <= c + dc < w:
        r += dr
        c += dc
        if out[r][c] == 0:
            out[r][c] = 2
    return out
